note: Draft defines 'knot; rice ball' (different senses, joined). JLPT hint is ending/conclusion; the example also uses that sense.

changes.def_ja_standard: 物事の終わり。しめくくり。
changes.def_en_standard: ending; conclusion — the closing part of something
changes.def_zh_standard: 结尾；结束 —— 事情或文章的最后部分

note: Joins two senses (tie/connect and associate). Reduced to the single sense 'tie together/join'; example changed to match.

changes.def_ja_standard: 二つのものを結んで一つにつなぐ。
changes.def_en_standard: tie together; join — to attach by knotting
changes.def_zh_standard: 系上；连接 —— 用结把两者连在一起
changes.example_ja: ひもでふたつをむすびつけた。

note: Simple uses the word itself; standard joins 'empty' and 'futile'. Reduced to the single sense 'empty/vacant'.

changes.def_ja_simple: なかになにもなくて、さびしい。
changes.def_zh_standard: 空虚；空洞 —— 里面没有实质内容

note: Joins 'useless', 'unnecessary' and 'forbidden' (してはいけない) senses. Reduced to 'useless'.

changes.def_en_standard: useless; of no use — serving no purpose
changes.def_zh_standard: 无用；无益 —— 没有用处

note: Standard joins 'solely' and 'mainly'. Reduced to the JLPT sense 'solely/exclusively'.

changes.def_ja_simple: それだけをするようす。
changes.def_ja_standard: ほかのことをせず、そのことだけをするようす。
changes.def_en_standard: solely; exclusively — doing only that one thing
changes.def_zh_standard: 专门；一味 —— 只做这一件事

note: Joins 'treat guests warmly' and 'feast them' (また、ごちそうする). Reduced to the single sense.

changes.def_ja_standard: 客を心をこめて迎えて扱う。
changes.def_en_standard: to entertain; to treat — to welcome guests warmly
changes.def_zh_standard: 招待；款待 —— 用心对待客人
